description.value: Ali Baba Pizza is a Vancouver Island pizza chain with its original Victoria location on Fort Street in the downtown core. The menu spans classic and premium pizzas, donairs, wings, salads, and a dedicated vegan pizza line, giving cyclists with varied dietary needs solid options. Online ordering with delivery across central Victoria neighbourhoods makes it a convenient refuelling stop after a ride.
